verdict.rationale: Moss documents that it embeds on-device with a built-in model, so no separate embedding pipeline is needed (moss-docs-17). The GitHub repo also lists built-in embeddings as a core feature (moss-gh-1). The only alternative documented is a `custom` model, which means bringing your own precomputed vectors rather than configuring a hosted provider. Missing for 10: configurable third-party model providers (e.g., hosted embedding APIs), explicit documentation that query text is embedded automatically at query time, details on built-in model choice and quality, independent or hands-on corroboration.
